issueCreateConfirmation.scope: any request for the github.issue.create effect under any revision of this artifact
issueCreateConfirmation.enforcement: tests/packed/s13ExternalEffectAuthorization.mjs fails closed with EXTERNAL_AUTHORIZATION_ISSUE_CREATE_UNCONFIRMED before any gh command, staging directory or approval when the confirmation is absent or mismatched; externalAuthorizationDecisionInputV1 also refuses to derive an issue-create approval from an unconfirmed authorization object
issueCreateConfirmation.rationale: The prospective artifact lists github.issue.create among covered effects, but the user's most recent explicit instruction was 'Do not create a repo or issue'. Coverage is not consent: an explicit, per-authorization confirmation is required.

residualProvenanceLimitation: The authorization artifact and the confirmation are user-supplied data; the deterministic loader is the trust gate and cannot itself prove human origin. The campaign records the artifact digest, the authorizationId, and (when applicable) the confirmation channel in every lane.
